title: Control Towers · Authority · Source / Artifact Libraries
federated_model: A7 resolves normative ownership and routing; each domain module owns its specific control contract and executable source; original Drive/A9 controls retain private normative authority until proven superseded.
privacy_notice: Only public-safe control names/categories and paraphrased responsibilities. No private Drive IDs, folder paths, source bytes or Main Library rows are published.
nonclaims: No public page or generated JSON is an owning provider.
R&D JSON workflow files are not proof full current private university/PPTX/LaTeX controls have been migrated.
A7-SEQ-000013 remains staged; private A9 migration and Main ACK are not completed.
Library pointers and control status do not establish artifact existence or institutional approval.

nodes.label: A7 Global Control Plane
nodes.summary: One semantic identity and authority router for connected systems; controls which repository or provider owns each fact.

nodes.label: Global policy & boundaries
nodes.summary: Authority precedence, human QA, public safety, module governance, routing, typed edges and conflicts.

nodes.label: Project / module registry
nodes.summary: Stable project IDs and module-resolution entrypoints. A route never proves a specialist project-specific artifact exists.

nodes.label: R&D Research Control Tower
nodes.summary: Owns researcher workflows, templates, source-build scripts, code/pointer registries and presentation/LaTeX lifecycle—not global provider rules.

nodes.label: Repository governance
nodes.summary: Main stores code, contracts and links; private manuscript bodies and generated PDFs/PPTX stay in Drive.

nodes.label: Discussion workflow
nodes.summary: Google Doc is the discussion authority; Git holds only pointers, provenance and approved workflow logic.

nodes.label: LaTeX source & build
nodes.summary: Git owns admitted .tex/.bib and build scripts; compile and QA; uploaded PDF is a Drive deliverable.

nodes.label: Presentation source & build
nodes.summary: Machine control recommends TypeScript + PptxGenJS + JSON/YAML, renders and QAs outputs, saves PPTX/PDF in Drive.

nodes.label: Research website workflows
nodes.summary: Optional verified researcher websites are source-controlled and deployed via review; no invented site branches.

nodes.label: Peer engineering modules
nodes.summary: Structural, CAD, Cost, Scheduling, Operations and Study modules each own their executable tools and domain contracts; this map shows the delegation role.

nodes.label: A9 private Drive Control Center
nodes.summary: Legacy/current private normative-control warehouse: read-first rules, save/version protocols, role assignments, source evidence and snapshots. Not migrated by simply linking Git.

nodes.label: AI Tool Control Tower v0.42
nodes.summary: Controls capability/plugin selection, connector routing, address-first retrieval, checkpointing and canonical ownership.

nodes.label: Thesis Control Tower v1.23
nodes.summary: Thesis-wide source admission, official formatting precedence, canonical folder model, reproducible LaTeX source and release QC.

nodes.label: Presentation Control v2.2
nodes.summary: Current presentation read order, official university/supervisor gate, institutional logos, PDF/PPTX outputs, slide geometry and visual QC.

nodes.label: Save Router & Workspace Protocol
nodes.summary: A9 PRE/readback/POST, append-only registration, version enumeration, owner/address resolution and Local/Main ACK; full live comparison remains open.

nodes.label: Main / Local Library System
nodes.summary: Original Drive registry and locality model for stable artifact identities, navigation, typed edges, revisions, local checkpoints and Main consumption acknowledgements.

nodes.label: Main Library Index
nodes.summary: ArtifactRegistry, ArtifactEdges, version/run tracking, AddressLookup and system-wide discovery; private values are not copied into the public graph.

nodes.label: Owning Local Library
nodes.summary: Per-project/lane catalogs, controls and mutation cursors; local reconciliation/ACK precedes meaningful Main consumption.

nodes.label: Governed Deliverable Release
nodes.summary: Resolve authoritatively: research/project inputs → reproducible code → build QA → verified Drive PDF/PPTX → local lineage → approved Main ACK.

nodes.label: A7 read-only navigation site
nodes.summary: Generated public-safe map, graph, documentation and routing projections. Website never becomes source of domain fact truth.

prioritized_roadmap.title: Close public-safe SEQ-000013 accurately
prioritized_roadmap.done_when: Revalidate Git/Drive bootstrap, bridge dry run, PR and provider state; no false private A9 cutover.

prioritized_roadmap.title: Pin global versus module-control boundaries
prioritized_roadmap.done_when: Link public-safe ownership and source contracts in A7; future changes pass per-repo QA.

prioritized_roadmap.title: Inventory executable thesis/PPTX/LaTeX constraints
prioritized_roadmap.done_when: Compare live Drive v1.23/v2.2 with R&D Git controls and actual templates/generators; classify adopted/partial/missing/conflicting.

prioritized_roadmap.title: Create contract-of-contracts with semver
prioritized_roadmap.done_when: For each rule: ID, owner, scope, version, source, dependency, validator, exception, privacy class, last verified and evidence.

prioritized_roadmap.title: Bridge Git release → Drive artifact → Local/Main ACK
prioritized_roadmap.done_when: Reconcile current/private IDs, historic edges, locators, Main/Local cursors and ACK before importing candidates.

prioritized_roadmap.title: Automated cross-repo drift + site navigation
prioritized_roadmap.done_when: Add CI assertions for manifests, owner links, artifact contracts, stale versions and broken public links.

prioritized_roadmap.title: Operator dashboard / reusable project templates
prioritized_roadmap.done_when: Read-first playbooks, versioned institutional templates, checklists, exception reviews, updated per-workstream dashboards.

policy_samples.latex: Read latest private thesis formatting/source control plus R&D LaTeX workflow; do not assume Git JSON includes exact font/margin/package rules.
policy_samples.presentation: Read private v2.2 and official institutional constraints before rendering; R&D PptxGenJS workflow is execution contract, not replacement authority.
policy_samples.libraries: Local→Main ACK is distinct from storing PDFs or Git commits. No blind imports.
policy_samples.governance: Source truth follows the provider and fact class; route is not artifact existence.
